featureType.name: Municipal_Ward_Boundary
featureType.title: Municipal Ward Boundary
featureType.abstract: Compiled from various sources and based off the County Jurisdictions dataset, this layer represents to municipal electoral wards for the last election. Updated every four years in line with municipal election cycles.

nativeCRS.$:

    AXIS["Geodetic longitude", EAST], 
    AXIS["Geodetic latitude", NORTH], 
    AUTHORITY["EPSG","4326"]], 
  PROJECTION["Popular Visualisation Pseudo Mercator"], 
  PARAMETER["semi_minor", 6378137.0], 
  PARAMETER["latitude_of_origin", 0.0], 
  PARAMETER["central_meridian", 0.0], 
  PARAMETER["scale_factor", 1.0], 
  PARAMETER["false_easting", 0.0], 
  PARAMETER["false_northing", 0.0],
